showcase.pilotTitle: Every flight is backed by a verified ground pilot.
showcase.pilotText: Partner operators assign certified remote pilots to every mission — from pre-flight SOP verification through landing and digital handover.
showcase.pilotCaption: Drone view of remote pilot during landing near Moab, Utah
showcase.anatomyTitle: Eight hardware subsystems keeping an aircraft stable in flight.
showcase.anatomyText: Select any hotspot to inspect how the flight controller, multi-constellation GNSS receiver, 3-axis gimbal, smart battery, and telemetry link feed the platform.
showcase.p1Text: Reads IMU gyroscopes, accelerometers, barometer, and compass to adjust motor speeds hundreds of times per second along the GIS route.
showcase.p1Spec: Control loop: hundreds to thousands Hz
showcase.p2Text: Tracks multi-constellation GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, and BeiDou satellites for navigation and geotagged aerial capture.
showcase.p2Spec: Multi-constellation GNSS: GPS · GLONASS · Galileo · BeiDou
showcase.p3Text: Determines endurance. Software monitors per-cell voltage, SOH health, and triggers safe return-to-home thresholds.
showcase.p4Text: Paired with dedicated ESCs on each arm, steering the aircraft smoothly via differential rotor RPM.
showcase.p5Text: Counter-rotating diagonal rotor pairs cancel yaw torque while generating clean vertical thrust.
showcase.p6Text: Rigid carbon-fiber geometry minimizes high-frequency vibration for optical sensors while folding compactly for field transport.
showcase.p7Text: Stabilizes 4K RGB cameras, radiometric thermal imagers, LiDAR scanners, or multispectral arrays across pitch, roll, and yaw.
showcase.p8Text: Bidirectional radio link carrying command uplinks and streaming live telemetry and HD video back to the ground station.
showcase.historyTitle: More than a century of aerial perspective.
showcase.historyText: From kite-mounted cameras to today's unified UAV service marketplace and flight coordination software.
showcase.e1Text: Arthur Batut in France suspended a timer-triggered camera from a kite to capture the earliest uncrewed aerial photographs.
showcase.e2Text: George Lawrence lifted a panoramic camera on a kite train to document citywide damage weeks after the earthquake.
showcase.e3Text: Uncrewed helicopters entered commercial rice-field spraying, pioneering industrial UAV operations.
showcase.e4Text: Ready-to-fly GPS quadcopters brought aerial imaging to engineers, surveyors, and field researchers.
showcase.e5Text: Civil aviation authorities established formal small-UAS pilot licensing and commercial operating frameworks.
showcase.e6Text: GNSS mapping, thermal grid inspection, and multispectral analytics became everyday engineering workflows.
showcase.e7Text: Connecting clients with verified UAV service providers and coordinating every mission stage on one software platform.

termsPage.title: Operating rules, mandatory partner credentials, and settlement framework.
termsPage.intro: Defines UAV PAS's role as an intermediary software platform, required legal/aviation documents for UAV providers, and milestone settlement rules.
termsPage.sec1Title: 1. Role of the UAV PAS Software Platform
termsPage.sec1Body: UAV PAS provides GIS flight planning software, airspace safety checks, telemetry monitoring, encrypted deliverable storage, and digital coordination between Clients and independent UAV Service Providers. Field flight operations are executed by verified partner operators.
termsPage.sec2Body: Before publishing listings or accepting coordinated orders, each Fleet Partner must file and maintain verified documents in Partner Profile:
termsPage.doc1: Business Registration Certificate or legal representative government ID / Passport.
termsPage.doc2: Remote Pilot Certificate and aircraft serial / technical registration records.
termsPage.doc3: Commercial flight operation authorization / airspace permit and third-party liability insurance.
termsPage.doc4: Signed Platform Service Fee Schedule Addendum & Settlement Policy acknowledgment.
termsPage.doc5: Tax registration dossier and verified corporate/beneficiary bank account for payout reconciliation.
termsPage.sec3Title: 3. Escrow Holding, Deliverable Acceptance & Fee Schedule Addendum
termsPage.sec3Body: Illustrative escrow records are tracked per order reference. Platform service rates follow the live platform configuration for each Fleet Partner plan and settle only after the Customer confirms deliverable acceptance.
